title: GTA 6 Has a Secret Portal Back to the Original Vice City 🌀 #Shorts
description:
Players found a hidden Tommy Vercetti easter egg in GTA 6. Twelve power substations across Leonida carry letters that spell "Life is passing me by", a cheat code from 2002's GTA Vice City. Solve it and a text from an unknown number sends you to a power station at night, where a portal takes you into a retro, PS2-style Vice City. The reward: Tommy Vercetti's shirt and his motorcycle. First found by YouTuber Memeio.

Sources: GameSpot (How To Get Tommy Vercetti's Shirt And Bike In GTA 6), Game Rant, Sportskeeda.
Images: Rockstar Games (official trailers / An Extended Look). Shirt shot is illustrative.
Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
